typedef struct platform_event_loop platform_event_loop_t

Native asynchronous networking. Call handle operations on the loop thread. post() and stop() may be called by other threads. The caller owns the loop thread and must join it before destroy(). No application callback may block. WASM uses browser transports and does not build this backend.
